$description: Compatibility / rhythm rules. Each rule id is implemented in schema/semantic_validate.py RULES with the same severity; verify_all.py (GRAPH_VALIDATOR_AGREEMENT) fails on any mismatch.

rules.rule: Draft-07 validation against schema/pagespec.schema.json (closed objects, enums, const-locked motion fallbacks).
nodes must follow the declared template's ordered node list; nothing unknown, repeated (unless repeatable) or out of order.
every required template node (section + variant) must be present.
the route matches the template's routePattern; a real route is served by exactly its mapped template; not-found only for unknown paths; reference routes must be real.
a reference PageSpec reproduces its route's measured composition (templates/routes.json) exactly.
at most one HERO; article and not-found templates have none (named exception: hero-less templates).
hero, statement stages, WebGL backdrop, pointer trail and grid overlay exist only on the home route.
onePerPage/maxPerPage constraints, keyed by (section, variant) so the three stage-headline variants may coexist.
hero.banner / article.header are the first in-flow section.
contact.footer-cta / article.meta-footer are the last in-flow section.
fixed shell, backdrop and overlay nodes precede all in-flow nodes.
the 4 statement stages share one sticky 8-viewport container: primary, secondary, sentences, closing, contiguous.
article.toc only with at least one article.chapter.
overlay.image-lightbox present exactly when the article has zoomable figures.
two adjacent in-flow sections of the same category are flagged; named exceptions STATEMENT (one sticky stage container), ARTICLE (sequential body parts), SHELL.
every text field respects its contract maxWords (Latin tokens + CJK chars/2).
motion pattern allowed for the section and paired with its single reducedMotionFallback.
asset roles must be ones the section uses.
registry availability must equal the in-code PINNED_AVAILABILITY.
runtime/utility sections (RETRIEVAL_INELIGIBLE pin) can never be marked retrievalEligible.
content sections cannot be marked ineligible.
style values must be catalog tokens.
no raw hex/rgb/hsl/lab colours.
no raw px/rem/vh lengths.
fonts only from the catalog fontFamily tokens.
each style field accepts only its category/prefix.
theme-specific tokens only with their theme (system needs both).
scene-scope (WebGL) colours only on BACKDROP.
text.on-accent only on accent.selection surfaces.
generated pages contain no source brand, project or organisation name (policy/source-identity.json) and use a generation-safe mark.
no owner name, handle or email.
only relative routes or reserved .example/.invalid hosts; no source hosts.
no plugin-store listings, package pages or downloadable archives of the source.
no source copy: named phrases (punctuation-insensitive, also across a node's lines) and 6-word / 8-char shingle fingerprints.
no source call-to-action strings.
only generation-safe roles listed in the section's generatedAssetRoles, with generated:/user-supplied:/placeholder:/glyph: or reserved-host refs; no source asset paths.
no ratings/reviews (the source has none; no section supports them).
